notes: Department apply page covers all Mathematics and Statistics graduate programs, including the Statistics and Data Science PhD. Deadline: January 15 for full consideration; financial offers March 16; acceptance decision April 15. The department says it will not waive the application fee. The GRE-Q/GRE-V 70th/40th percentile figures on the apply page are expectations, not requirements.
